relationships.evidence: Landing and status pages state the background database is BAFU/UVEK 2026.
relationships.constraints: BAFU attribution and share-alike terms apply to derived datasets.
relationships.validation_question: Track the BAFU/UVEK version per EDB-BAFU release.

relationships.evidence: The status page states the shipped package contains zero ecoinvent references; the provider publishes twin maps from source background activity keys to BAFU/UVEK twins.
relationships.constraints: Source background version is not stated on the public pages; deleted edges return floors.
relationships.validation_question: Independent check that no proprietary references remain in the distributions.

relationships.evidence: The package README states the bundle ships the products EOS declares plus everything they draw on.
relationships.constraints: Scope follows the EOS recipe roster and moves between releases.
relationships.validation_question: Confirm which EOS release consumes which EDB-BAFU version.

relationships.evidence: The landing page links a hosted Firefly catalog seeded by the same publish run and documents bw2package import.
relationships.constraints: Firefly project/database availability depends on the published catalog.
relationships.validation_question: Verify the hosted catalog version matches the release.
